name.ja: セミラグランジュ法：所与球面回転の限定例
name.en: Semi-Lagrangian transport: a limited prescribed sphere rotation

summary.ja: 逆向き特性から出発点を求めて補間する方法。ここでは厳密な剛体回転の出発点と双線形補間だけを用います。
summary.en: Trace backward characteristics and interpolate at departure points; this example uses exact rigid-rotation departures and bilinear interpolation only.

code_mapping_scope: Scoped fixed-input examples; original method variants and earlier releases remain distinct.

references.label: Nair, Cote and Staniforth (1999), Cascade interpolation for semi-Lagrangian advection over the sphere
references.scope: Selected author-hosted solid-body/bell formulas; this implementation is bilinear, not their cascade algorithm. Original W92 full text remains unread.

assumptions: Only prescribed scalar solid-body rotation on a unit sphere. Original W92 equations remain unread; selected Nair author formulas cross-check conventions. Both grids use eleven noncommensurate remaps. Bilinear interpolation is nonconservative; report mass drift and do not claim temporal convergence or a nonlinear global SWE core.
assumptions_ja: 単位球の所与の剛体回転によるスカラー輸送だけです。原W92全文の式は未閲読で、Nairらの選択した著者資料との規約照合に限ります。両格子とも11回の非整合なremap。非保存の双線形補間で質量ずれを報告し、時間収束とは呼びません。
boundary_conditions: Periodic longitude; explicit pole reflection with a pi longitude shift.

limitations.ja: 単位球の所与の剛体回転によるスカラー輸送だけです。原W92全文の式は未閲読で、Nairらの選択した著者資料との規約照合に限ります。両格子とも11回の非整合なremap。非保存の双線形補間で質量ずれを報告し、時間収束とは呼びません。
limitations.en: Only prescribed scalar solid-body rotation on a unit sphere. Original W92 equations remain unread; selected Nair author formulas cross-check conventions. references.title: Reformulation of Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics with Riemann Solver
references.read_scope: Author PDF selected passages in sections3.1.1/3.2/3.3/3.4 and4.1, equations48–52,66–67,79–85,94 and Figure6 caption. No new whole-paper audit. Gaussian convolution overlap, variableh approximation and matched pair energy are distinguished from substituting star pressure into ordinarySPH.
references.limits: Draft will use the linear specific-volume overlap and first-order pair reconstruction, not the paper cubic/MUSCL production variant. Variableh is the paper approximate formulation, not a rigorous grad-h variationalSPH scheme.

references.authors: Yan Tan; Hui Lv; Jun Zhu
references.title: New Third-Order Finite Volume Unequal-Sized WENO Lagrangian Schemes for Solving Euler Equations
references.read_scope: Publisher full-text Example8, equation42 and Figures8–9 captions: 2D skewedpiston geometry and finite nonzero internalenergy. Only the benchmark configuration is borrowed; the new solver is not that WENO/Lagrangian method.
references.limits: Saltzman/Colella1985 LA-UR-85-678 is cited historically but original full text was not obtained. Later papers use different skew maps/cold pressures; they must not be silently mixed.

references.title: Second Order Corner Coupled Upwind Transport Methods for Lagrangian Hydrodynamics
references.read_scope: Bibliographic identity found in the authors LLNL comparison report reference27, not the original1985 report.
references.limits: Do not claim original1985 parameters or originalmethod reproduction.

references.authors: D. L. Williamson; J. B. Drake; J. J. Hack; R. Jakob; P. N. Swarztrauber
references.title: A standard test set for numerical approximations to the shallow water equations in spherical geometry
references.read_scope: DOE/ORNL1991 author-report bibliography/abstract and suite identity. FullPDF/page fetch timed out; do not mark original equation read.
references.limits: Primary author implementation/formula confirmation still required before claiming exactstandard W92 parameterreproduction.

references.authors: Ramachandran Nair; Jean Côté; Andrew Staniforth
references.title: Cascade interpolation for semi-Lagrangian advection over the sphere
references.read_scope: Author-hosted selected section3 gives velocity/bell formulas and explicitly distinguishes radius7pi/64 from W92 radius1/3.
references.limits: Selected solidbody-rotation definitions only. Our bilinear tensor interpolation is not their cascade algorithm; our radius1/3 uses the W92-associated variant, not their7pi/64 radius. Original W92 full text remains unread.
references.journal: Quarterly Journal of the Royal Meteorological Society
